fullGoalSnapshot.title: Gewinnung seltener Metalle für Spannungsquellen diskutieren
fullGoalSnapshot.titleEn: Discuss extraction of rare metals for electrochemical sources
fullGoalSnapshot.description: Die lernende Person kann die Rohstoffgewinnung seltener Metalle für elektrochemische Spannungsquellen an geeigneten Beispielen fachlich diskutieren.
fullGoalSnapshot.descriptionEn: The learner can discuss extraction of rare metals for electrochemical sources using suitable examples and scientific reasoning.

goalPayloadHashDefinition: SHA-256 over UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=false, sorted object keys, separators comma and colon; goal payload before proposed resourceLink

referenceStrategy.strategy: Friendly comic language described in prompt; no copied existing image or layout.

selectedScientificExample: Platinum, a rare precious metal, used as a catalyst in selected PEM fuel cells. No rare-earth classification or all-battery claim.
selectionReason: DOE identifies platinum as rare and specifically explains its catalytic role in PEM fuel cells. A fuel cell is an electrochemical source, so this fits the full goal without imposing a lithium/cobalt example or inventing an extraction reaction.

proposedResourceLink.title: Visualisierung: Gewinnung seltener Metalle für Spannungsquellen diskutieren
proposedResourceLink.description: Beispiel Platin: vom Erzabbau zum Katalysator einer PEM-Brennstoffzelle.
proposedResourceLink.altText: Eine vereinfachte Route zeigt Erzabbau mit Gestein, eine geschlossene Aufbereitungsanlage, ein Stück Platin und dessen Verwendung als Katalysator in einer PEM-Brennstoffzelle. Wasserstoff und Sauerstoff führen zur Zelle, ein Blitz steht für elektrische Energie. Unter dem Abbau stehen die Gesprächsfaktoren Fläche, Wasser und Energie.

authorActualInspection.native: Raw-material extraction occupies the left half and is followed by a symbolic enclosed processing building, refined metal and a specifically named PEM fuel cell. H2/O2 arrows and the electrical output cue identify the electrochemical application. Extraction discussion factors Fläche/Wasser/Energie are prominent. There is no blast furnace or extraction formula.
authorActualInspection.phone360: Erzabbau, Platin, named fuel cell, large feed arrows and three discussion icons remain recognizable; the long PEM label and catalyst label are smaller but readable. No required paragraph or numerical detail.
authorActualInspection.card680: All labels and the material-to-application path are clear.
authorActualInspection.styleAndPerspective: Comic outlines, large motifs, warm mining colours and pale-blue/teal accents fit the inspected style. No person/work-surface perspective is asserted.
authorActualInspection.remainingRisks: The cell stack is an abstract symbol, not a reviewed literal layer architecture. The catalyst pointer targets a central highlighted stripe; an independent reviewer should check any membrane/catalyst ambiguity. The mine type and processing building are symbolic; they do not specify a universal platinum extraction route. Area/water/energy are qualitative discussion factors, not measured platinum-site impacts.
